objective: Answer « très statique »: the plate moves. A selection is a carrier that travels, a scope change is a cut that lands from the side the dial turned, and the nameplate enters with the selection.

the_mechanisms.the_carrier: the selection mark is a bar, not a row highlight. It leaves the line it occupied and travels to the line chosen on the application's own out-curve, keeping its departure through every repaint the voyage crosses. The selected row's accent underline and its left border were removed: one mark only.
the_mechanisms.the_scope_cut: the readout is a cut, not a fade. On a scope change the recess lands displaced from the side the dial turned (44 px) and closes the distance over 280 ms. No opacity layer is placed around the virtualised list: it dims the whole window, and a fade is not a cut.
the_mechanisms.the_plate_entry: the nameplate's content lands 22 px low and rises into its band over 220 ms. It is a displacement, not a fade.
the_mechanisms.the_banks_front: the bank has a front now: the anchor carries its full name, what it holds and its count; the narrow apertures carry their short name (AppImage, Tracked), and the seven counts share one line so they can be compared at a glance.
the_mechanisms.the_quiet_plate: with nothing selected the nameplate names the bank instead of centring « No Package Selected » in a wide band.

what_was_proved.the_offset_that_moves_nothing: in this version of gpui an inset on a flow child is ignored: a probe of 240 px over two seconds slid an absolutely positioned child and left a flow child exactly where it was. Every animated surface is therefore laid out absolutely inside a band that carries the real geometry.
what_was_proved.the_scope_entry_seen: at 1080 × 935, the readout is ~35 px off its seat on the first captured frame after the change and back on it by the fourth (frames 76–146 ms after the click).
what_was_proved.the_plate_entry_seen: the name's top at 673, then 652, then 651 — 22 px of travel closed in ~80 ms.
what_was_proved.the_carrier_seen: the bar at 470..505 at 80 ms and at 368..403 at 107 ms while leaving the seventh row for the first, settling pixel-aligned on its row.
what_was_proved.the_name_that_collapsed: under the absolute wrapper the package name disappeared: a flex child with ellipsis and no basis resolved to zero width. `.flex_1().min_w_0()` restores it, and the version stays pinned to the right.
what_was_proved.the_tab_body_is_safe: switching to Dependencies leaves the window's header mean exactly unchanged (34.1, 34.3, 45.6 before and after): the inspector's opacity cut does not dim the application.

the_artefacts.what: cut_travel, carrier_travel, SCOPE_ENTRY and PLATE_ENTRY durations, and their tests
the marker and its epoch, the readout's recess, the nameplate's entry, the pure rules advance_marker, carrier_top, scope_order
the neutral row: background only for the selection, one mark
the anchor's full name, the short names, the counts on one line
the name takes the remaining room
A17–A21, the motion table, and the gaps that are still true

the_gates.local: scripts/verify — PASSED, run local-verify-20261021T055750Z, 1386 package-manager tests, 235 UI tests
the_gates.ci_replay: scripts/ci-replay --worktree — PASSED inside archlinux:latest on a clean checkout, run local-verify-20261021T060013Z, 1388 package-manager tests, 235 UI tests

the_environment.a_red_gate_that_was_not_the_code: the first run of this pass failed 79 package-manager tests, all of them in SyncTestWorkspace, which writes to /tmp/calix-alpm-test-*. /tmp was 100 % full: an orphaned pw-cat, eleven hours old, was still writing to a deleted /tmp/opencode/cap.wav and held 7.8 GB of unlinked inodes. Releasing it returned /tmp to 7.3 GB free and the suite to 1386 passing.
the_environment.the_rule_it_teaches: a suite that fails en masse in its filesystem tests is a machine, not a commit, until the filesystem says otherwise.

the_gaps: A8 is open: the filters menu still offers the sources, bound to the same selection, while the bank is meant to be the only source control
the inspector's tab body still animates its opacity only; its `left` offset falls on a flow child and moves nothing
the carrier's geometry inside the virtualised list is proved by the pure rule and by the frames, not by a test that lays the list out
the synthetic keyboard of this machine never reaches the client, so the three-second help gesture remains unproven by hand
